tools.name: check_site_for_webmcp
tools.description: Check a web page for WebMCP tools (registered and form tools), their schemas, and the site's AI catalog (ai-catalog.json) and llms.txt. Returns every tool found and every issue, the way Lighthouse's Agentic browsing audits see them.

tools.name: find_relvato_checks
tools.description: Find which of Relvato's website checks watch for a given problem or risk. Returns each matching check with what it verifies, the platforms it works on, and its page. Use it to answer whether Relvato can monitor something.

need.description: What to watch or prevent, in plain words — e.g. "checkout breaks after a plugin update", "SSL certificate expiring", "a hacker adds an admin account".

tools.name: get_relvato_pricing
tools.description: Get Relvato's plans (Free, Pro, Business, Agency): monthly price in USD (and billed annually), what each adds, its limits (sites, runs per month, history), and the full feature comparison.

tools.name: notify_me_when_available
tools.description: Ask Relvato to email once when monitoring for shopify launches. The person reviews the address and submits it themselves.

tools.name: search_relvato_docs
tools.description: Search Relvato's documentation and guides. Returns the best-matching articles with a one-line summary and their URL.

query.description: The question or topic, e.g. "send alerts to Slack" or "why does WordPress malware come back".

tools.name: send_contact_message
tools.description: Write a message to the Relvato team (support, sales, integrations, feedback or anything else). The person reviews the filled form and sends it themselves.
